name: pread64
synopsis: ssize_t pread64(int fd, void *buf, size_t count, off64_t offset);
description: pread64() reads up to count bytes from file descriptor fd at the specified offset without changing the file offset. It is the Linux-specific version of pread() with a 64-bit offset for large files.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Buffer to store the read data

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of bytes to read

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset from the beginning of the file

return_value.success: Returns the number of bytes read (0 indicates end of file)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, errno is set

errors.description: See read(2) and lseek(2) for details, as pread64() can fail with errors from those calls
